module.label: League stats
module.description: Records matches and handles trusted viewer requests.

flows.label: Live game data changes
flows.detail: The collector preserves live observations and chat handling during InProgress/Reconnect. Historical downloads, archive enrichment, catalogue and rank refresh wait until gameplay ends. Pending work and explicit import/refresh intent remain queued; the public status explains the deferral. The existing worker resumes optional work after leaving those phases, including after a transient live-feed disconnect. Personal combat and all global objective times are retained, with bounded ten-second personal telemetry and explicitly observed level/item changes. Stale polls cannot rewind a capture. No extra worker is created. After gameplay, the same worker verifies end-screen identity and reads bounded client timelines. Riot finishes the newest match timeline before older backfill. A 403 match response triggers a paced platform authorization check: a valid key skips that restricted match for an hour; a refused key pauses requests. The key and response bodies never enter public status. Accepted live snapshots also advance the local 6–7 finder: exact player K/D 6/7, 67 CS and either team-score orientation. A silent initial baseline, per-match deduplication and 12-second spacing prevent noise; delayed finds must still be true. The state owner emits outside its lock through the existing Hub event stream, with no Twitch post or new worker.

flows.label: A viewer asks for stats
flows.detail: Stat and guide requests share viewer cooldowns. Live answers require fresh telemetry. Matchups use confirmed roles and the same known queue. Lifetime answers respect account/exclusion/custom-game filters. Named helpers undo their own last entry; moderators and broadcaster can correct others. Failed, stale and duplicate requests stay quiet.

steps.label: Read saved session or persist helper observation
Show overlay and enqueue a compact threaded reply
steps.detail: Only after acceptance, with chat replies enabled. Help lists commands without replacing a card. The delivery worker rejects expired feature intent.

flows.label: Game ends
flows.detail: Preserve partial observations on disconnect without claiming a result. Matching final stats enrich the same archive row. The Match Chronicle appears only for the recent current match in a confirmed between-game phase, and hides on gameplay, queue, replay, lost client or expiry. Scene routing stays with the existing League owner.

effects.intent: Save and enrich the match record
effects.protection: Stats persistence is independent of lobby scene ownership.

flows.label: Present stats to streamer and viewers
flows.detail: Match Chronicle uses one feature-owned monotonic playhead shared by the Hub controller and OBS, with eight visual pages every twelve seconds. Confirmed matchmaking, ready check and champion select admit the latest completed account match without a fifteen-minute expiry; lobby, end screens, gameplay, replay and unknown client phases hide it. Native scene routing shows the League client in the idle lobby and exclusively selects the recap in queue, including the private ban stage; the draft scene takes over at picks. The existing collector observes phase edges even when browsers are unloaded. Queue entry starts at Highlights; ready check and draft preserve progress. A new match resets manual intent. Hide disables automatic display persistently; Auto enables it; manual Show is bounded to thirty minutes and cannot bypass phase or current-match gates. Match/revision validation rejects stale controls. Manual page/detail choices hold for thirty seconds, then resume; explicit Pause persists until Play. Overview uses participation, team damage and survival rings. Combat ranks measured teammate damage and separates physical, magic and true damage. Tempo and Economy chart sampled time, lane gold and wallet balances without filling gaps or guessing recalls. Build shows item art and ability order; Vision and Moments retain personal combat and both-team objective context. Story uses measured fight-window timelines, covered same-champion/role/queue baseline bars, farm comparisons, cast bars and survival rings with short labels. Missing facts remain unavailable, never zero, and no skill grade or causal objective claim is invented. Native 960 by 540 and 640 by 360 layouts prioritize chart area; all reported stats and complete events remain in controller details. Official artwork uses the existing cache. Report calculation stays cached by revision with identity-checked timeline evidence. Hidden browser reads cancel; controller mutations are bounded to one in flight; collapsing the Hub iframe disposes its polling and observer. No new worker, timer, transport, settings default, archive write or volume write is introduced. The automatic source inherits the existing shared display and all saved per-world placements.

steps.label: Derive at most 12 completed games with stat gaps
Compute goal pace only from fresh reported CS
Render chart and preview chosen overlay view
Return to selected or available rotating view
steps.detail: OBS requests only viewer fields, avoiding editor tables, charts and reply previews. Hidden documents and OBS sources cancel polling; returning starts a fresh request and rejects stale responses. Export reads the archive directly without building the desk report.
